raw_text:
Install dependencies and build the plugin.

export BRAINTRUST_API_KEY='your-api-key'
export BRAINTRUST_PROJECT='your-project-name'
export BRAINTRUST_DEBUG=true

Config: `.opencode/braintrust.json` or `~/.config/opencode/braintrust.json`. Keys: `trace_to_braintrust`/`TRACE_TO_BRAINTRUST` (`false`); `project`/`BRAINTRUST_PROJECT` (`"opencode"`); `debug`/`BRAINTRUST_DEBUG` (`false`); `api_key`/`BRAINTRUST_API_KEY`; `api_url`/`BRAINTRUST_API_URL` (`"https://api.braintrust.dev"`); `app_url`/`BRAINTRUST_APP_URL` (`"https://www.braintrust.dev"`); `org_name`/`BRAINTRUST_ORG_NAME`.
